entities.name: PMID:10727545
observations: Human study of pre-dialysis uremic/CRF patients, hemodialysis patients, and healthy controls.

B-cell numbers were reduced in both uremic groups; unstimulated cultured lymphocytes showed increased apoptosis, especially in B cells, and apoptotic B cells correlated with B-cell lymphopenia at 48 hours.
In-vitro Bcl-2 expression was lower; Fas did not explain the spontaneous apoptosis phenotype.
The study supports association, not causality, because Bcl-2 was not experimentally manipulated.

entities.name: Uremia
observations: Associated in the primary human study with reduced circulating B-cell abundance and increased spontaneous ex-vivo B-cell apoptosis.
The observed phenotype coincided with reduced Bcl-2 expression, but causation was not established.

entities.name: Uremic B-cell apoptosis
observations: In pre-dialysis and hemodialysis patients, cultured peripheral lymphocytes had increased spontaneous apoptosis, most pronounced in B cells; apoptotic B-cell percentage correlated with B-cell lymphopenia.
The phenotype was associated with lower Bcl-2 expression; other Bcl-2-family members were not established in the available evidence.
